purpose: Test a source-faithful XAUUSD M15 swing-liquidity sweep -> sweep-body order block -> later body-through confirmation entry, with and without the published H1 EMA50 trend component, under the frozen DELTA 30-second execution surface.

public_logic_sources.source: MQL5 CodeBase 77639 — SMC Gold: Liquidity Sweep and Order Block EA for XAUUSD M15
public_logic_sources.logic: M15 five-left/five-right confirmed swing; wick exceeds swing by >=0.15 ATR14 and closes back; sweep candle body becomes order block; H1 EMA50 trend filter; within next 3 M15 bars confirmation closes through order-block body with range >=0.3 ATR.

source_reconstruction_note: The downloadable mq5 binary endpoint was not retrievable through the research transport. Public CodeBase text is sufficiently explicit for a faithful causal entry reconstruction. 'Close through the order block' is preregistered as bullish close above max(sweep open,sweep close) and bearish close below min(sweep open,sweep close). H1 trend is evaluated from the most recently completed H1 close and EMA50 to avoid intrabar lookahead.
independence: Not prior-day high/low: uses fresh causally confirmed local M15 swing identities.
Not prior SFP family: requires a later separate confirmation bar to traverse the sweep candle body.
Published sweep size, swing lookback, ATR period, confirmation window and confirmation-range defaults remain fixed.
No FVG/BOS dependency, session filter, oscillator, or post-result side split.

R037-SOBR-C01_M15_BODY_H1EMA50.trend: most recently completed H1 close above EMA50 for long / below EMA50 for short
R037-SOBR-C01_M15_BODY_H1EMA50.confirmation: long close above sweep body high; short close below sweep body low

R037-SOBR-C02_M15_BODY_NO_TREND.confirmation: long close above sweep body high; short close below sweep body low

proposal_timing: first executable tick at/after completed M15 confirmation bar edge

execution.note: DELTA execution/risk semantics remain frozen; source EA's ATR stop/2R exit is not imported in this entry-source screen.

screen_gate.winner_or_quality_gate: official-win delta nonnegative OR positive net with improved gross loss
